cat > diagnosis.json <<'EOF'
{"spec_element": "requires",
 "proof_obligation": "bridge",
 "diagnosis": "queryFast lacks the precondition 0 <= i <= j <= a.Length. Without it, the postcondition sum(a, i, j) is not well-formed (sum requires 0 <= i <= j <= a.Length), the call proof(a, 0, j, k) with k == i cannot satisfy the lemma's requirement 0 <= k <= j <= a.Length, and c[i]/c[j] indexing is unjustified. Adding the missing requires clause fixes all errors."}
EOF
sed -i '35a\  requires 0 <= i <= j <= a.Length' program.dfy && sed -n 34,38p program.dfy && dafny verify program.dfy
